name: model-routing-gate
description: Passive configured-model and subagent lifecycle diagnostics for Codex

interface.shortDescription: Observe configured subagent routing and lifecycle coverage.
interface.longDescription: Records bounded configured-model and subagent lifecycle diagnostics without gating native spawn, follow-up, wait, interrupt, or completion. Codex SubagentStart reports an active model but no reasoning or requested-to-actual binding, so the model is passive context and actual model and reasoning remain Unverified unless a separate authoritative provider supplies evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Record bounded subagent routing diagnostics without blocking native collaboration.
